def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    van_patches = image_patch.find("silver van")
    stall_patches = image_patch.find("market stall")
    
    if not van_patches or not stall_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    near_stalls = [v for v in van_patches if distance(v, stall_patches[0]) < 0]
    
    return near_stalls[0] if near_stalls else van_patches[0]
